notes.title: The theme song PV of "Kirakira stars project Nagisa" is now on view!
notes.content:
Hello!
We support "Sushi soft".
"Let's getting started", the theme song for "Kirakira stars project Nagisa", is now available on YouTube and the Steam Store page.
YouTube：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_CIuC_0eNFk

This time, the theme song is sung by 'Misaki Todo' acting 'Nagisa Yukishiro', the main character of this game.
Don't miss the music video which looks like she is singing on stage!
This PV is used in an important scene in the game as well, so please check it out.
It's now 30% off until June 26th.

Song Title: "Let's getting started"
Song: Nagisa Yukishiro (Vo. Misaki Todo)
Movie: gram6design
Songwriting: Angel Note
Lyrics: Riryka
Composer: Shunsuke Shiina

Thank you for your continued support of "Sushi soft".
